resources.string: Clearer object names with an outlined orbit-color dot and more space beside the arrows.
Larger solid-color counters for objects, points and scenarios, with digits that adapt to the theme.
More room in Daily path: compact reminder buttons and uniformly thin bells.
Types ordered by object count, alphabetical sorting options and clearer object controls.
Steadier reference labels and Nadir at −90°, opposite Zenith.
Improved moon motion, selected-object close approaches and explicit weather-loading status.
